descFull: Self-hosted photo intelligence, enrichment, curation, and automation for your Immich library. Pictaria Server helps you explore and understand your collection, optionally enrich it with AI, review your best photos, and build Smart Albums that stay up to date—all through a private web dashboard running on your hardware.
